_comment: Canonical shape of one <doc_id>_enriched.json file, committed so a consumer can
read the contract without running the pipeline (issue #6, C4).
The file itself is a JSON ARRAY of records shaped like 'example_records' below —
this object is the documentation of that array, not the array. 'example_records'
is the only part a program should read; everything else is prose for humans.
The model returns only the four fields under 'enrichment' that the constrained
llm_client_shared.attach_category_ids) and is absent when EMIT_CATEGORY_IDS=false;
the surrounding record fields (file_id … original_text) come from the input row.
tests/test_prompt_template.py asserts these field names stay in step with the
schema and with the examples in prompts/system_prompt.txt, so the three cannot

fields.aborted: always true; the marker exists only on an aborted document
fields.errors_before_abort: consecutive inference errors that triggered it

fields.file_id: document id, from the input CSV's 'file' column
fields.categ: OCR line-quality class carried through from the input (e.g. Clear)
fields.quality_score: float in [0,1] carried through from the input
fields.original_text: the exact source line the model was asked about

enrichment.extracted_keywords_cs: Czech terms found IN the line; [] when teater_category is the meta-text sentinel
enrichment.extracted_keywords_en: English translations of extracted_keywords_cs, same length and order
enrichment.teater_category: one label from the controlled vocabulary, or 'Nerelevantní (meta-text)'; a B3 bracketed qualifier is stripped back off here
enrichment.confidence_score: float in [0,1]; the model's confidence in teater_category, used for filtering
enrichment.teater_category_ids: every {source, id} record the chosen label stands for — its own plus everything dedup absorbed onto it (M7). Present only when EMIT_CATEGORY_IDS=true

example_records.original_text: Výzkum odhalil základy gotického kostela ze 14. století.
